company.name: CliniDo
company.shortDescription: CliniDo is a HealthTech Startup that Simply Connects patients with Healthcare providers Through an online platform.
company.description:
CliniDo is a MedTech company that helps patients make and schedule appointments with doctors, archiving their medical records on the app. 
Our main profession is tackling the real pain facing the patients in finding and booking appropriate healthcare providers, in addition to the problem of managing and archiving their medical records, also we're helping the healthcare providers in digitizing their practice and use our innovative solution in improving their service level.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform that allows patients to search for and book appointments with healthcare providers across various specialties and locations.
productsAndServices.name: Online Doctor Booking Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that facilitates remote medical consultations between patients and doctors via voice or video calls through the platform or app.
productsAndServices.name: Online Medical Consultations (Teleconsultations)

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables patients to schedule in-home visits by healthcare providers through the CliniDo platform or app.
productsAndServices.name: Home Visit Booking Service

productsAndServices.description: A service that lets patients book medical lab tests online and have samples collected from their homes by specialized teams.
productsAndServices.name: At-Home Lab Test Booking and Sample Collection

productsAndServices.description: A feature providing patients with access to medical articles, videos, and a symptom-based doctor recommendation tool.
productsAndServices.name: Medical Content and Symptom Checker

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Angel round raised $240,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,799,981 to $1,799,981, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 71 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
